entry.title: AEE 2027 preliminary website
entry.content: AEE 2027 is proposed for FSE 2027. Building on software engineering economics, the workshop explores resource allocation, cost–benefit trade-offs, and value creation throughout the lifecycle of AI agent systems. The overview and topics have been updated. Tentative 2027 deadlines (AoE): submission February 11; notification March 18; camera-ready April 8.
